records.detail: zip 4.6.1 is pulled only by tauri-plugin-updater, which extracts an update after verifying its signature against the built-in public key, and only in builds carrying the updater key.
Transitive GTK binding of the Linux Tauri build; the affected iterator is not called by first-party code.

records.rule: desktop app sends its app key to the engine port without re-verifying the engine identity after startup
records.detail: Medium. engine.rs get_json/settings send the app key every 20 s with no /health/identity check after Engine::start; the orca CLI re-checks before every request. Withheld; private report pending (PVR disabled, email channel).

records.rule: streaming include_usage=false records zero cost (desktop agent budget)
records.detail: Low. chat.py keeps an explicit include_usage=false, so an agent key can stream at 0 recorded cost and never trip the soft daily budget. Mentioned in the private report as a secondary note.
